obligations.note: Payments' privileged idle limit is 10 in both policy.py and controls/payments/policy-params.json, and 10 is within the approved maximum of 15. The two artifacts match, and session enforcement code was not changed.
Ticket CHG-24417 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt before review, and its components payments.policy and payments.controls-data cover policy.py and controls/payments/policy-params.json.
Mara Costa, a payments change approver and not the author, gave a code_review approval on commit 1d8360e591d64feda330816cfcb2f5b25c3409ab.
The change is a single commit, and both the code_review and control_owner approvals name that head commit.

run.json claims a successful payments suite on the head commit, but the JUnit report is timestamped 2026-10-23T13:30:21-07:00 on dev-laptop-7.local, four days before that commit. That report does not show the suite, including the SES-1 control test, passing on the final commit.
The touched components payments.policy and payments.controls-data are not marked security_sensitive, so a security_review approval is not required.
The approved idle-timeout parameter is a protected controls path, and Rachel Stein of the controls office, outside payments-eng, approved it as control_owner on the head commit.
The ticket type is standard and the change is not marked emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.
The new limit stays inside the SES-1 bound, so no exception is required. Expired exception EXC-0141 is not relied on.
Acceptance-ledger entries cover other files and symbols, and this diff does not change their behaviour. SES-1 is judged from the updated parameter artifacts on this commit.

summary: The idle-timeout change itself is within policy: both the code constant and the approved payments parameter are 10 minutes, which is at or under the 15-minute ceiling, and the ticket, independent code review, and control-owner approval match the single head commit. Testing evidence does not. The JUnit report attached to the CI run is dated 2026-10-23 on a workstation, before commit 1d8360e5 on 2026-10-27, so it does not show the payments suite passing on the final commit. CHG-4 is therefore not met and the change is rejected.
